threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the veggie stall at Ridley Road Market is just a fancy grocery store, not a local lifeline.
Last night on the 60, a guy serenaded the bus with Adele. Oddly beautiful until he asked for a duet. Everyone just pretended to be asleep.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Hearing a kid at the playground say 'Ich will kein Gemüse!' while their mom's on a video call, I realized this place really mixes cultures like no other.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a kebab shop opening at 5 AM, serving hungry clubbers fresh döner while the sun rises over Görlitzer Park.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows the best taco truck isn't on a smartphone map—it’s the one at 24th and Potrero that opens at 3 AM after the bars close.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a couple trying to fit a full-size guitar through the exit door at Civic Center while a dog lounged on the tracks. Classic Muni chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think café con leche is just for mornings. You'll see locals sipping it in the evening, not just for the caffeine but for the moment.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll see them holding a map upside down, looking bewildered while trying to navigate the 1200 tapas bars within a two-block radius.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just 'the overground'—that’s a dead giveaway around these parts.
Caught a whiff of Jerk chicken on the 50 last night; turned out to be a guy with a full takeaway. Brixton’s late-night culture, right there in a nutshell.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a wedding party feed a flock of pigeons outside the Rathaus while their friends danced in the street—then realized it was just another Saturday.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find 'Berliner' donuts filled with jellies named after local legends. Grab one while waiting for the U-Bahn during a strike!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they can name at least three taco trucks by the burnt-out 16th Street BART station and know who serves the best salsa.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo waiting for the bus outside the bar, checking his watch like he was late to the Oscars. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'la mejor terraza' means the busiest one. Real locals know the best spots are the hidden ones with no signs, just good vibes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new by how they still gawk at the Mercat de Sant Antoni like it’s a museum, while the rest of us just want our groceries.
